Vanessa / Aditya / Tessa —

Lunos has signaled that the POC is complete and they want to move to production next week. We need a short ops handoff focused on observability: dashboards, tracing hooks, alert taxonomy, and an initial runbook for the primary payment-authorization flow. High level asks from the customer: 

- Dashboard templates for 95th/99th latency, token throughput, and per-route error rates.
- A tracing snippet and recommended span naming for Redwood requests proxied by their API gateway.
- Alert taxonomy that maps errors to severity (P0/P1/P2) and recommended paging rules (PD escalation, Slack, email).
- A one-page runbook stub for the auth flow (how to triage and failover to fallback model).

I attached two artifacts we collected during implementation: a wiring diagram and our suggested alert taxonomy (not final). Can you own the ops side and propose an ownership map + meeting slot? Prefer to have the handoff recorded; Lunos will need a short walk-through.

Attachments:
- lunos-wiring-v1.drawio (diagram of network paths + routing policies)
- alert-taxonomy-v0.3.xlsx (customer-provided priorities + initial mapping)

Next steps I propose:
1) Ops review + ownership map by EOD tomorrow.
2) 45-minute recorded handoff with Lunos the day after (they prefer mornings PST).
3) Deliver runbook draft within 3 business days after handoff.

Thanks — I can share the Confluence link if helpful.

— Monica

Vanessa — couple of technical pointers to include in the runbook and tracing guidance:

1) Tracing samples: ask Lunos to sample at 1% by default for cross-service traces and 10% for requests that hit the auth flow, then bump to 100% when an alert fires.

2) Suggested span tags: 
- rw.request_id (string)
- rw.model_name (string)
- rw.token_count (int)
- rw.kv_cache_hit (bool)

3) Error taxonomy suggestion (short):
- model-internal-error => P1, notify channel "#prod-model-errors" and create Jira with tag model-fault
- external-network-failure => P0 if >5% of requests in 5m window, page on-call SRE
- auth-timeout => P1, escalate to customer PSC after 2 mins

4) Dashboard panels to prioritize: 99th latency by route, request-rate heatmap (per model), model cache hit ratio, and per-replica GPU memory pressure.

I can paste a small tracing middleware snippet in the call if helpful — it’s a 6-line insertion for their gateway (OpenTelemetry compatible).

— Aditya
